Existing Industry Problems (The Broken Status Quo)

1. Multi-Asset Contradiction Leaks

CRITICAL RISK
  • Desynchronized Channels: Instagram caption claims 20% OFF while banner graphic declares 30% OFF.
  • Channel Leaks: Tiered subscriber discounts mistakenly broadcast to general public ad feeds.
  • Silent Contradictions: Disclaimers tucked away in terms PDFs contradict headline social ad copy.

2. Unsubstantiated Scientific Claims

REGULATORY FINE
  • Engineering Drift: Copywriters state "24-hr cold retention" when lab certs only validate 12 hours.
  • Superlative Violations: Unapproved words like "Miracle", "Cure", or "Guaranteed" evade manual eye checks.
  • Omission of Mandatory Qualifiers: Missing required caveats ("While supplies last", "T&C Apply").

3. Velocity vs Legal Friction Bottleneck

OPERATIONAL LOSS
  • Review Gridlock: Creative teams generate 50+ ad variants weekly; legal takes 4–7 days per audit.
  • Rushed Sign-offs: 64% of brands bypass formal legal clearance under tight campaign launch deadlines.
  • Manual Fatigue: High error rates when human reviewers manually cross-check PDF terms against images.

4. Post-Approval Silent Tampering

LEGAL LIABILITY
  • Out-of-Band Mod: Creators edit approved copy or swap banner PNGs at 11 PM directly before go-live.
  • Lost Traceability: Zero immutable record showing what was legally approved vs what was actually aired.
  • No Revocation Engine: No system detects when an approved asset hash is modified post-sign-off.

The Core Governance Breakdown

Failure Vector What Happens in Current Workflow Regulatory & Business Damage

EXECUTIVE BRIEF • SEC-02 • SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE
SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE

What We Fix: The 4-Layer Automated Trust Loop

Transforming subjective, manual ad reviews into deterministic mathematical compliance and cryptographic locks.
PILLAR 01

Single Source of Truth

  • Campaign Contract: Canonical baseline of discount %, dates, approved claims, and banned terms.
  • Versioned Truth: Immutable contract revisions (v1, v2) with audit provenance.
PILLAR 02

4-Layer AI Preflight

  • Automated Scan: Audits social copy, banner images, and spec sheets simultaneously.
  • Contradiction Flags: Instant grounding against active contract parameters.
PILLAR 03

Cryptographic Locking

  • SHA-256 Hash Seal: Binds approved assets to contract version cryptographically.
  • Auto-Revocation: Any post-approval tamper instantly revokes the seal to INVALIDATED.

The 4-Layer Inspection Protocol Breakdown

Layer 1: Deterministic Campaign Facts & Math

DETERMINISTIC
  • Discount Verification: Matches caption and graphic numbers to contract offer % (e.g. 20% vs 30%).
  • Date & Expiry Alignment: Flags expired end dates or mismatches between graphic and calendar.
  • Channel Variant Protection: Checks if an exclusive VIP discount is leaking into public channels.

Layer 2: Cross-Asset Consistency Engine

MULTIMODAL AI
  • Caption vs Banner vs PDF: Compares Instagram text with embedded banner text and PDF sheets.
  • Specification Verification: Verifies advertised claims against technical engineering limits.
  • Desynchronization Prevention: Flags when banner graphics say one thing and captions say another.

Layer 3: Brand Rules & Superlatives

LEGAL NLP
  • Prohibited Terms Detection: Traps regulatory trigger words ("Miracle", "Cure", "Unbeatable").
  • Approved Claim Enforcement: Ensures pre-approved marketing claims are used verbatim.
  • Required Disclaimers: Enforces mandatory qualifiers ("While supplies last", "Selected models only").

Layer 4: Multimodal Vision & Accessibility

OCR & VISION
  • OCR Banner Extraction: Extracts burned-in text and numbers inside PNG/JPEG graphics.
  • Visual Contrast Verification: Tests text legibility against background brightness (WCAG AA).
  • Alt-Text & Transparency: Generates semantic compliance tags for accessibility compliance.

How We Fix Issues in Real-Time: 1-Click Harmonization

Automated Reconciliation Engine

1-CLICK REMEDIATION
  • Evidence Grounding: Shows exact ground truth rule from contract alongside contradictory creative text.
  • Suggested Replacements: System suggests verified copy (e.g. rewrites "24hr cold" to "12hr lab-tested cold").
  • 1-Click Accept: Creator or reviewer accepts fixes with one click, immediately recalculating pack hash.

EXECUTIVE BRIEF • SEC-05 • ATTACK VECTORS & SCENARIOS
TEST BENCHMARKS

Multiple Real-World Scenarios Tested

Real compliance failure simulations demonstrating CampaignGuard's automated detection and resolution.
SCENARIO 01

Flash Sale Discount Discrepancy & Channel Leak

LAYER 1: FACTS
Creative Input Creator uploads banner stating "30% OFF Flash Sale" and caption stating "20% OFF".
Contract Truth Contract v1 allows 20% discount for Public, and 30% ONLY for VIP Email Subscribers.
Engine Finding CONTRADICTION: Banner claims 30% discount on public Instagram feed, exceeding 20% limit.
Remediation System auto-corrects banner reference to 20% or suggests re-routing post to VIP channel.
SCENARIO 02

Scientific Exaggeration vs Engineering Spec Sheet

LAYER 2: CROSS-ASSET
Creative Input Ad copy claims: "Miracle thermal lock guarantees 24 hours ice cold drinks for everyone!"
Contract Truth Lab spec document certifies cold retention for up to 12 hours under laboratory conditions.
Engine Finding INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE: 24-hr claim lacks scientific basis; conflicts with 12-hr spec sheet.
Remediation Copy rewritten to: "Keeps drinks cold for up to 12 hours based on certified thermal tests."
SCENARIO 03

Prohibited Superlatives & Omitted Legal Disclaimers

LAYER 3: BRAND RULES
Creative Input Caption uses the prohibited word "Miracle" and lacks mandatory qualification disclaimer.
Contract Truth Contract explicitly forbids "Miracle", "guaranteed", "cure-all"; requires "While stocks last".
Engine Finding PROHIBITED TERM DETECTED: Word "Miracle" violates Section 43(a) trademark/ad regulations.
Remediation Word "Miracle" stripped; mandatory qualifier "While supplies last on selected items" appended.
SCENARIO 04

Post-Approval Out-of-Band Asset Tampering

LAYER 4: CRYPTO REVOCATION
Attack Simulation After Marcus Vance (Reviewer) locks pack with SHA-256 seal, creator edits text to 35% discount.
Crypto Engine Recalculates SHA-256 payload hash of modified assets; compares with registered signature.
System Action INSTANT REVOCATION: Campaign status switches from APPROVED to INVALIDATED.
Result Distribution blocked, audit log records actor name, timestamp, and unauthorized payload.

GO-TO-MARKET STRATEGY

Target Markets, Stakeholder Personas & Approach

Defining who buys CampaignGuard, who uses it, and our frictionless enterprise land-and-expand strategy.

1. Targeted High-Stakes Market Segments

D2C & FMCG Consumer Brands

PRIMARY BUYER
  • Pain: High-volume ad creative churn across Meta/TikTok with frequent discount desyncs.
  • Value: Eliminates checkout discount errors, customer churn, and false advertising complaints.

Regulated Health, Wellness & Cosmetics

HIGH REGULATORY RISK
  • Pain: Strict FDA, FTC, and ASCI guidelines regarding health claims and product superlatives.
  • Value: Guaranteed adherence to lab-certified claims; prevents multi-million dollar class-actions.

FinTech, Banking & Credit Cards

MANDATORY DISCLOSURE
  • Pain: Complex APR rates, cashback caps, and required statutory qualification disclaimers.
  • Value: Ensures mandatory qualifiers are legally compliant across all visual formats.

Creator Agencies & Influencer Networks

HIGH VELOCITY
  • Pain: Managing 200+ influencers who write their own rogue copy ignoring brand briefs.
  • Value: Preflight verification tool given to creators before posts go live.
